gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Bruno Ace draws every letter with a ruler-straight, constant-width line, each character getting its own lingering beat. Noto Sans Linear B glides smoothly around its bends, so enlarge it freely.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Letters bent like cable into shapes, never swelling or thinning, give Bruno Ace its stamp. Noto Sans Manichaean is the plain sans beneath, its crossbars left open.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Expressive and a little showy, Bruno Ace strings its strokes along a path like stitched thread with counters left open to the outside. Noto Sans Mongolian follows with flared terminals, a modern plain sans that lets the heading do the performing.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lu: Bruno Ace has a flat, stencil-cut feel, every stroke of a single weight, with counters that stay open to the outside. Shrink it, and Noto Sans New Tai Lue's cupped round letters would quickly outweigh it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-nko: Distinctive is the word for Bruno Ace, which keeps every stroke free of any hairline-to-stem shift and lingers one character per beat. Noto Sans NKo, a plain sans, simply stays modern and see-through in its openings, leaving the showmanship to the heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoin: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace makes every diagonal as stout as every upright, with a lingering one-character-per-beat rhythm. Noto Sans NKo Unjoined is the approachable plain sans below, so a slightly larger size suits it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-old-south-: Bruno Ace holds the same line width through curves and straights, with counters that stay connected to the outside. And Noto Sans Old South Arabian, a clean plain sans whose curves end before turning inward, would feel approachable down a whole page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian brings rope-loose curves that never knot at their ends, a clean contemporary plain sans. Against it, Bruno Ace's rod-built letters make the strongest quality of the pair: a sharp, deliberate difference.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ojuju: Approachable is the right word for Ojuju, whose faint thick-thin rhythm recalls crayon on rough paper, while Bruno Ace above it has no hairlines at all. Wide, barely curled s curves would keep a longer page feeling loose and easy.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-overpass: A ruler-drawn, constant-width line defines Bruno Ace, with its counters staying connected to the outside and each character lingering. And Overpass, a modern sans-serif, keeps its strokes uniform within each word, so a long page would read smoothly.
